question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **curb** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct filler to be used in option 4 is curb.​​ • The word curb means 'to limit or control something, especially something bad (**नियंत्रण में लाना**)' • Ex: *He needs to learn to **curb** his anger.* • The sentence of the cloze test containing blank (4) tells that more steps are needed to be taken in order to **put a limit (curb)** on the rate of road accidents. *Therefore, the correct answer is option 1).* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • The Government is taking seriously the (1) issue__ of road safety and is committed to reducing the number of people killed in accidents. Forums are being conducted (2) __regularly__ to bring law-makers, law enforcement officers and road users together to discuss ways to (3) __tackle__ the rise in road accidents. Everyone agrees that more needs to be done on road safety in its determination to (4) __**curb**__ the rate of road accidents in the country. The Government, with the cooperation of relevant agencies, is making serious (5) ______ to instil proper road culture in children, young adults and the public in general. 46:T12c1,
